sources.entry: ImageOptim - GUI image optimizer for Mac.

summary.one_liner: ImageOptim is a Mac GUI that losslessly optimizes image files by running a set of command-line image compressors on them.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ImageOptim as a graphical front end for lossless image optimization tools, naming Zopfli, PNGOUT, OxiPNG, AdvPNG, PNGCrush, JPEGOptim, Jpegtran, Guetzli, Gifsicle, SVGO, svgcleaner and MozJPEG. It is built as an Xcode project that pulls in these tools as git submodules. The README covers only the build process and does not describe the user-facing workflow in detail. The listing in the source list identifies it as a GUI image optimizer for Mac.
use_cases: Shrink PNG file sizes without losing quality
Optimize JPEG images for the web
Batch-reduce image sizes on a Mac
Strip unnecessary data from SVG graphics
how_to_run: Open imageoptim/ImageOptim.xcodeproj in Xcode (it downloads and builds subprojects automatically)
If build errors occur: git submodule update --init
If needed, cd into gifsicle (or pngquant), run make clean, then make
notable: Wraps many separate lossless optimizers behind one GUI
Pulls tool sources in as git submodules and builds them in Xcode
Covers PNG, JPEG, GIF and SVG formats
caveats: Requires Xcode and Rust installed via rustup (not Homebrew), so building from source is a developer task
Build problems may need manual submodule updates or running make inside individual tool folders
README does not state platform minimums or the license
